title: Documentation delegation request
description: Optional request format for a documentation-writing subagent. Use project-relative paths within the CLI working root. Filesystem checks belong to the caller; this schema describes the request only.

objective.description: State what the writer should write, revise, or clarify.

target_documents.description: List project-relative paths to the human-facing documents the writer may edit. List missing documents only when creation is authorized.

audience.description: Identify the intended readers and their expected background when relevant.

desired_reader_outcome.description: State what readers should understand or be able to do after reading.

finalized_changes.description: For implementation or design updates, summarize the resulting behavior and agreed decisions. Omit abandoned approaches and debugging history. Omit this field for writing tasks without such changes.

evidence_manifest.description: Optionally identify a selective set of existing files that support the request. Do not require an evidence manifest for every writing task.

path.description: Give a project-relative path to an existing evidence file.

relevance.description: Explain what this file helps the writer verify or understand.

facts.description: Optionally summarize the relevant facts supported by this file.

constraints.description: List task-specific limits, required terminology, or structure to preserve.

validation.description: List relevant documentation checks the writer may run. Omit when none are needed.

uncertainties.description: List unresolved facts, proposals, or open questions the writer must not present as agreed behavior or decisions.

allow_create.description: Set true to authorize creating missing target documents. When absent or false, update existing documents only.
